_source: 'rate_limit', 'forbidden_scope', 'validation_org' and 'unauthorized_text' are RECORDED FROM THE DOCS (not live output): the 429, 403, 422 and 401 examples of https://docs.apollo.io/reference/organization-enrichment and /people-enrichment, plus https://docs.apollo.io/reference/status-codes (error_details shape) and https://docs.apollo.io/reference/rate-limits (retry-after header), fetched 2026-10-04. 'out_of_credits_code', 'out_of_credits_message' and 'echoes_key' are UNVERIFIED: Apollo does not document its out-of-credits response. '{KEY}' is replaced with the test's sentinel key.

rate_limit.message: The maximum number of api calls allowed for api/v1/people/match is 600 times per hour. Please upgrade your plan from https://app.apollo.io/#/settings/plans/upgrade.

error_details.message: You have made more API requests than your plan allows in this time window.

suggestions.label: Wait until the rate limit resets, then retry the API request.
Check the Apollo Docs to understand API rate limits.

window.description: The rate limit window that was exhausted

forbidden_scope.error: This API key is not authorized to access api/v1/organizations/enrich. Request an API key from your administrator that includes this endpoint in its configured scope.

error_details.message: Your team is not permitted to call this endpoint.

suggestions.label: Contact support@apollo.io if you need access to this endpoint

error_details.message: Include a company name, domain, website URL, or LinkedIn URL to find a match.

suggestions.label: Retry the request with a name, domain, website_url, or linkedin_url parameter included

out_of_credits_code.error: You have run out of credits.

error_details.message: Your team has no credits left for this request.

out_of_credits_message.error: Insufficient credits to complete this request. Please upgrade your plan.

cases.unauthorized_text: Invalid API key. See https://docs.apollo.io/reference/authentication for how to authenticate.

error_details.message: The credential {KEY} could not be authenticated.
